definitions.explanation: To extend something flat over a surface.
To install or construct by laying down in position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}く。
⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧クロス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}いた。
examples.english: I spread a cloth on the table.

examples.japanese: ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧カーペット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}いて、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{温|あたた}かくなった→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: I laid carpet on the floor and the room became warmer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{線路|せんろ}→線路：04041_senro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}く。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦パイプ→パイプ：00338_paipu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}く⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Construction to lay new pipes has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{線路|せんろ}→線路：04041_senro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敷|し}く⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったが→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}になった→中止：03481_chuushi⟧。
examples.english: There were plans to lay railroad tracks in this area, but they were canceled due to budget issues.

notes:
{敷|し}く means to spread or lay something flat over a surface.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: {布団|ふとん}を{敷|し}く

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {布団|ふとん}を{敷|し}く: to lay out a futon
- {線路|せんろ}を{敷|し}く: to lay railway tracks
- {敷|し}き{布|ふ}: fitted sheet, bottom sheet
- {敷|し}き{物|もの}: mat, rug

CONTRAST:
- {敷|し}く: to spread flat (futon, cloth)
- {広|ひろ}げる: to spread open (newspaper, map)
